whyItMatters: Without the SameSite attribute the browser attaches cookies to cross-site requests, which lets attacker sites ride the victim's session (cross-site request forgery).
actions: Set SameSite=Lax on every cookie, Strict for sensitive sessions.
Use SameSite=None only with Secure for intentional third-party use.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the attribute is observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes SameSite on the target's cookies.
